name: Nandurbar Municipal Council prabhag boundaries (2025 final map, traced)

metadata.accuracyNote: Scale is pinned to the official 32.41 km2 council area; rotation to the railway centreline; position to Nandurbar station. Expect roughly +/-100 m in the built-up core and worse in the peripheral lobes.
metadata.fitnessForUse: ward lookup and review; not legal boundary determination or survey use

properties.sourceReference: Nandurbar Municipal Council General Election 2025 FINAL MAP (wall copy, Nagar Parishad); DocScanner scan + wide board photograph
properties.digitisationMethod: colour segmentation of printed boundary ink + cost-distance allocation from printed ward-number labels
properties.georeferencingMethod: similarity fit: rotation from railway centreline vs OSM, scale from official 32.41 km2 council area, position from Nandurbar railway station
